notes: ANALYTICS.RAW.TRIP_RESUME: Row-preserving silver model: no filtering, deduplication, joins, unions, or flattening.

ANALYTICS.RAW.TRIP_START: Row-preserving silver model: no filtering, deduping, flattening, or nested-field extraction.
ANALYTICS.RAW.TRIP_START: Includes all source columns from schema_columns as aliased raw passthrough fields, plus additive cleaned/derived/quality columns.
ANALYTICS.RAW.TRIP_START: EVENT_DATE is string-typed in schema, so this model keeps a cleaned event_date_raw text field and safely parses event_ts with TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ().

observation.content:
{{ config(alias="stg_raw_trip_start") }}

with staged as (
    select
        BIKE_ID as bike_id_raw,
        CRANK_TORQUES as crank_torques_raw,
        EVENT_DATE as event_date_source_raw,
        EVENT_TYPE as event_type_raw,
        HARDWARE as hardware_raw,
        ISBN as isbn_raw,
        LAST_CRANK as last_crank_raw,
        MESSAGE_TYPE as message_type_raw,
        METADATA as metadata_raw,
        RIDER_ID as rider_id_raw,
        TRIP as trip_raw,

        nullif(trim(BIKE_ID), '') as bike_id,
        nullif(trim(RIDER_ID), '') as rider_id,
        nullif(trim(ISBN), '') as isbn_text,
        nullif(trim(EVENT_DATE), '') as event_date_raw,
        try_to_timestamp_ntz(nullif(trim(EVENT_DATE), '')) as event_ts,
        nullif(trim(EVENT_TYPE), '') as event_type,
        nullif(trim(MESSAGE_TYPE), '') as message_type,
        CRANK_TORQUES as crank_torques,
        HARDWARE as hardware,
        LAST_CRANK as last_crank,
        METADATA as metadata,
        TRIP as trip,
        'ANALYTICS.RAW.TRIP_START' as source_relation,
        BIKE_ID is not null and (trim(BIKE_ID) <> BIKE_ID or trim(BIKE_ID) = '') as bike_id_was_normalized,
        RIDER_ID is not null and (trim(RIDER_ID) <> RIDER_ID or trim(RIDER_ID) = '') as rider_id_was_normalized,
        ISBN is not null and (trim(ISBN) <> ISBN or trim(ISBN) = '') as isbn_text_was_normalized
    from {{ source("RAW", "TRIP_START") }}
)
select
    bike_id_raw,
    crank_torques_raw,
    event_date_source_raw,
    event_type_raw,
    hardware_raw,
    isbn_raw,
    last_crank_raw,
    message_type_raw,
    metadata_raw,
    rider_id_raw,
    trip_raw,
    bike_id,
    rider_id,
    isbn_text,
    event_date_raw,
    event_ts,
    event_type,
    message_type,
    crank_torques,
    hardware,
    last_crank,
    metadata,
    trip,
    source_relation,
    event_date_raw is not null and event_ts is null as event_ts_parse_failed,
    bike_id_was_normalized,
    rider_id_was_normalized,
    isbn_text_was_normalized
from staged

{{ config(alias="stg_raw_trip_resume") }}

WITH staged AS (
    SELECT
        BIKE_ID AS bike_id_raw,
        CRANK_TORQUES AS crank_torques,
        EVENT_DATE AS event_date_source,
        EVENT_TYPE AS event_type_raw,
        HARDWARE AS hardware,
        ISBN AS isbn_raw,
        LAST_CRANK AS last_crank,
        MESSAGE_TYPE AS message_type_raw,
        METADATA AS metadata,
        RIDER_ID AS rider_id_raw,
        TRIP AS trip,
        NULLIF(TRIM(BIKE_ID), '') AS bike_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM(RIDER_ID), '') AS rider_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM(ISBN), '') AS isbn_text,
        NULLIF(TRIM(EVENT_DATE), '') AS event_date_raw,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(EVENT_DATE), '') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS event_ts,
        NULLIF(TRIM(EVENT_TYPE), '') AS event_type,
        NULLIF(TRIM(MESSAGE_TYPE), '') AS message_type,
        'ANALYTICS.RAW.TRIP_RESUME' AS source_relation,
        IFF(
            NULLIF(TRIM(EVENT_DATE), '') IS NOT NULL
            AND TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(EVENT_DATE), '') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) IS NULL,
            TRUE,
            FALSE
        ) AS event_ts_parse_failed,
        IFF(NULLIF(TRIM(ISBN), '') IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS isbn_text_present
    FROM {{ source("RAW", "TRIP_RESUME") }}
)
SELECT
    bike_id_raw,
    crank_torques,
    event_date_source,
    event_type_raw,
    hardware,
    isbn_raw,
    last_crank,
    message_type_raw,
    metadata,
    rider_id_raw,
    trip,
    bike_id,
    rider_id,
    isbn_text,
    event_date_raw,
    event_ts,
    event_type,
    message_type,
    source_relation,
    event_ts_parse_failed,
    isbn_text_present
FROM staged
